sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液也被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机地想要隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“无名氏”。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认了她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: Moving over 1,000 miles north to south, Highway Interstate 25 serves as the main route through
sentences.zh: 25号州际公路全长超过1000英里，由北向南贯穿

sentences.en: Wyoming, Colorado, and New Mexico.
sentences.zh: 怀俄明州、科罗拉多州和新墨西哥州。

sentences.en: The New Mexico portion of Interstate 25 runs through arid desert landscape, from looming mountain ranges to sand-swept, cracked plains of wild grass and dried brush.
sentences.zh: 25号州际公路在新墨西哥州境内穿过干旱的沙漠地带，从高耸的山脉到沙尘弥漫、布满裂纹的荒原，到处是野草和枯木。

sentences.en: This desolate landscape doesn't offer much in terms of excitement, and drives can be long and uneventful.
sentences.zh: 这片荒凉的土地没什么令人兴奋的地方，开车行驶在路上往往漫长而平淡。

sentences.en: Yet, every so often, a bustling cityscape emerges on the expansive horizon, with the highway providing a gateway to cities like Albuquerque and Santa Fe.
sentences.zh: 然而，每隔一段距离，广阔的地平线上就会出现繁华的城市景观，这条公路成为了通往阿尔伯克基和圣达菲等城市的门户。

sentences.en: At its southernmost point, the highway begins in the New Mexico city of Las Cruces.
sentences.zh: 这条公路的最南端始于新墨西哥州的拉斯克鲁塞斯市。

sentences.en: After just over an hour's drive northward, the road curls around the western edge of Truth or Consequences, a desert city bordering the Rio Grande River.
sentences.zh: 向北行驶一个多小时后，道路绕过了“真理或后果”城的西侧，这是一座毗邻格兰德河的沙漠城市。

sentences.en: Truth or Consequences earned its unique name after winning a competition with a popular radio quiz show in 1950.
sentences.zh: “真理或后果”城这个独特的名字源于1950年它在一场与热门广播问答节目的竞赛中获胜。

sentences.en: The tourism brochures for Truth or Consequences touts the one-road desert town as being only
sentences.zh: “真理或后果”城的旅游手册吹嘘这座沙漠小镇仅位于

sentences.en: 120 miles north of El Paso and 150 miles south of Albuquerque.
sentences.zh: 埃尔帕索以北120英里，阿尔伯克基以南150英里处。

sentences.en: In other words, it is quite literally in the middle of nowhere.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，它确实位于荒无人烟的中心地带。

sentences.en: Home to a year-round population of around 6,000 people, Truth or Consequences attracts those
sentences.zh: “真理或后果”城常住人口约6000人，吸引着那些

sentences.en: who prefer the vast isolation of the surrounding desert to living in the shadows of skyscrapers.
sentences.zh: 比起生活在摩天大楼的阴影下，更偏爱周围沙漠广袤孤寂感的人们。

sentences.en: Residents live in mismatched bungalows, mobile homes, or ranch-style houses on sun-baked lots.
sentences.zh: 居民们住在阳光炙烤的土地上，屋舍各异，有平房、移动房屋或牧场风格的住宅。

sentences.en: The small downtown area offers a selection of restaurants, lodging, dive bars, and access to the ancient hot springs that the town is renowned for.
sentences.zh: 小镇中心区提供各式餐厅、旅馆、酒吧，并可以通往该镇闻名遐迩的古老温泉。

sentences.en: Further north, the highway runs parallel to Truth or Consequences' neighbouring community,
sentences.zh: 再往北，公路与“真理或后果”城的邻近社区平行，

sentences.en: Elephant Butte.
sentences.zh: 即象山。

sentences.en: About five miles separates the two townships, with Elephant Butte being the smaller, quieter, and less populated of the pair.
sentences.zh: 两个城镇相距约五英里，象山是其中规模较小、更为安静且人口较少的一个。

sentences.en: Elephant Butte residents travel into Truth or Consequences when requiring services only available within the larger city.
sentences.zh: 象山的居民需要大型城市才有的服务时，会前往“真理或后果”城。

sentences.en: Occasionally, Truth or Consequences folk head up to Elephant Butte to visit the lake.
sentences.zh: 偶尔，“真理或后果”城的居民也会去象山游览湖泊。

sentences.en: On February 21, 1999, off-duty Sheriff's Deputy Gary Labor was heading north along Interstate
sentences.zh: 1999年2月21日，休班的警长副手加里·拉博正沿着25号州际公路
向北行驶。

sentences.en: As he drove outside Truth or Consequences, Labor caught sight of a hitchhiker on the side of the road.
sentences.zh: 当他开车经过“真理或后果”城外时，拉博看到路边有一名搭便车的女子。

sentences.en: The young woman motioned for him to pull over.
sentences.zh: 那名年轻女子示意他停车。

sentences.en: Always willing to offer rides to those in need, Labor rolled his car to a stop alongside her.
sentences.zh: 拉博一向乐于助人，便将车停在她身边。

sentences.en: The hitchhiker introduced herself as Angelica Montano, and she requested a ride 150 miles north to the city of Albuquerque.
sentences.zh: 搭车女子自称是安杰莉卡·蒙塔诺，她请求搭车前往150英里以北的阿尔伯克基市。

sentences.en: Labor was heading in that direction.
sentences.zh: 拉博正好也要往那个方向走。

sentences.en: So he agreed to drop the woman off at her destination.
sentences.zh: 于是他同意将她送到目的地。

sentences.en: The journey to Albuquerque would take about two hours.
sentences.zh: 前往阿尔伯克基的路程大约需要两个小时。

sentences.en: As the pair started cruising along the highway, Angelica initiated some small talk by casually remarking, You wouldn't believe what just happened to me.
sentences.zh: 当两人开始在公路上行驶时，安杰莉卡随口闲聊道：“你绝对不会相信刚才发生了什么。”

sentences.en: Deputy Labor asked her what happened.
sentences.zh: 拉博副手问她发生了什么事。

sentences.en: Angelica replied,
sentences.zh: 安杰莉卡回答说：

sentences.en: I was just kidnapped by a couple.
sentences.zh: “我刚才被一对夫妇绑架了。”

sentences.en: They held me in their house for a few days, raped me, tortured me, and then let me go just now on the highway.
sentences.zh: “他们把我关在屋子里几天，强奸了我，折磨我，然后就在刚才把我放到了公路上。”

sentences.en: Angelica went on to explain her encounter in more detail.
sentences.zh: 安杰莉卡继续详细讲述了她的遭遇。

sentences.en: Her story began with her abduction days prior and led to descriptions of extreme sexual torture.
sentences.zh: 她的故事从几天前的绑架开始，随后描述了极端的性虐待。

sentences.en: The laid-back ease in which Angelica recounted her ordeal was surreal to Deputy Gary Labor.
sentences.zh: 安杰莉卡讲述这段经历时那种轻松随意的态度，让加里·拉博副手感到不可思议。

sentences.en: It was as though she was casually retelling a rather uneventful experience.
sentences.zh: 就好像她只是在随口重述一件平淡无奇的小事。

sentences.en: Despite the distressing content of her story, Angelica showed no behavioural signs of trauma, which struck Labor as odd.
sentences.zh: 尽管故事内容令人痛苦，但安杰莉卡没有任何创伤的行为迹象，这让拉博觉得很奇怪。

sentences.en: Keeping his opinions to himself, Labor offered to take Angelica to a police station so she could make a formal report on the matter.
sentences.zh: 拉博没有发表意见，而是主动提出带安杰莉卡去警察局，以便她能就此事正式报案。

sentences.en: However, Angelica refused to go anywhere near a police station and showed no desire of reporting the incident.
sentences.zh: 然而，安杰莉卡拒绝靠近任何警察局，也表现出不想报案的意愿。

sentences.en: Given her relaxed demeanour and refusal to speak to authorities, Labor considered whether the woman was lying, perhaps to make the car ride more interesting.
sentences.zh: 鉴于她放松的态度和拒绝与当局交谈，拉博考虑这名女子是否在撒谎，也许只是为了让车程更有趣。

sentences.en: He didn't press the matter and the topic was dropped.
sentences.zh: 他没有追问，话题也就此打住。

sentences.en: Once they arrived in Albuquerque, Labor let Angelica out at a bus stop and bid her farewell.
sentences.zh: 到达阿尔伯克基后，拉博在公交车站让安杰莉卡下车，并与她道别。

sentences.en: Although noting the experience as bizarre, he didn't give it any more thought.
sentences.zh: 虽然他觉得这次经历很离奇，但并没有多想。

sentences.en: And soon, details of the encounter completely slipped from his mind.
sentences.zh: 很快，这次邂逅的细节就从他的脑海中完全消失了。

sentences.en: Just over a month later, Cynthia Veal's harrowing escape from David Parker Ray's House of Horrors was dominating national media.
sentences.zh: 仅仅一个多月后，辛西娅·维尔从大卫·帕克·雷的“恐怖之屋”死里逃生的消息震惊了全国媒体。

sentences.en: Reports of potentially dozens of women being held captive on a suburban property within the sleepy township of Elephant Butte was unlike anything anyone had ever heard before.
sentences.zh: 关于数十名女性可能被囚禁在象山这个宁静小镇郊区房产里的报道，是人们闻所未闻的。

sentences.en: Except for Deputy Gary Labor.
sentences.zh: 除了加里·拉博副手。

sentences.en: When he heard the news, memories returned of the hitchhiker he picked up on Interstate 25 from outside Truth or Consequences a month earlier.
sentences.zh: 当他听到这个消息时，记忆回到了一个月前他在“真理或后果”城外25号州际公路上搭载的那名搭车女子身上。

sentences.en: Her story of abduction and torture bore striking similarities to the one told by Cynthia Veal.
sentences.zh: 她讲述的绑架和折磨故事与辛西娅·维尔所说的有着惊人的相似之处。

sentences.en: Now convinced the hitchhiker had been telling the truth, Labor contacted the investigators who
sentences.zh: 现在确信那名搭车女子说的是真话，拉博联系了负责

sentences.en: were overseeing the David Parker Ray case and reported his interactions with the woman.
sentences.zh: 大卫·帕克·雷案件的调查人员，并报告了他与该女子的互动。

sentences.en: Investigators were convinced Labor had inadvertently crossed paths with another one of David Parker Ray's victiMs.
sentences.zh: 调查人员确信拉博无意中遇到了大卫·帕克·雷的另一名受害者。

sentences.en: Yet, complicating the matter was Labor's inability to recall the woman's name.
sentences.zh: 然而，让事情变得复杂的是，拉博无法回忆起那名女子的名字。

sentences.en: Despite this, the details of her suffering was something he could never forget.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，她所受苦难的细节却是他永远无法忘记的。

sentences.en: Around the same time that Gary Labor came forward with his story about the hitchhiker, investigators
sentences.zh: 就在加里·拉博站出来讲述搭车女子的故事的同时，调查人员

sentences.en: were contacted by a resident of Hot Springs Landing who lived near David Parker Ray's Bass Road home.
sentences.zh: 接到了一位住在温泉登陆区、靠近大卫·帕克·雷贝斯路住所的居民的联系。

sentences.en: The man claimed to have important information related to the case and agreed to participate in a formal interview.
sentences.zh: 该男子声称掌握与案件相关的重要信息，并同意接受正式采访。

sentences.en: His name was John Branner and he arrived to the police station accompanied by his wife,
sentences.zh: 他的名字叫约翰·布兰纳，他与妻子

sentences.en: Jean Branner.
sentences.zh: 简·布兰纳一起来到警察局。

sentences.en: The couple were acquaintances of Cindy Hendy, David Parker Ray's partner and co-accused.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇是大卫·帕克·雷的同伙兼共同被告辛迪·亨迪的熟人。

sentences.en: The Branners met Hendy when she first arrived in town in the summer of 97.
sentences.zh: 布兰纳夫妇是在亨迪97年夏天刚到镇上时认识她的。

sentences.en: Upon her arrival, Hendy had stayed in a motel managed by Jean Branner and Jean took Hendy under her wing.
sentences.zh: 亨迪刚到时住在一间由简·布兰纳管理的汽车旅馆里，简对亨迪颇为照顾。

sentences.en: The women became friends and Hendy would visit the Branners' house often.
sentences.zh: 两人成了朋友，亨迪经常去布兰纳家串门。

sentences.en: The Branners lived only eight blocks away from David Parker Ray, so after Cindy Hendy moved in with Ray, the Branners saw her more frequently.
sentences.zh: 布兰纳夫妇住的地方离大卫·帕克·雷家只有八个街区，所以辛迪·亨迪搬去和雷同居后，布兰纳夫妇见到她的次数就更频繁了。

sentences.en: During these visits, Hendy revealed a lot of intimate details about her relationship with Ray, some of which were so shocking they were hard to believe.
sentences.zh: 在这些拜访中，亨迪透露了许多关于她与雷关系的私密细节，其中一些令人震惊，让人难以置信。

sentences.en: During one of her recent visits to John and Jean's house, an intoxicated Hendy divulged a disturbing story about her boyfriend.
sentences.zh: 在最近一次拜访约翰和简家时，喝醉了的亨迪泄露了一个关于她男友的令人不安的故事。

sentences.en: Hendy revealed David Parker Ray had abducted and sexually tortured a woman in his trailer, holding her captive for several days.
sentences.zh: 亨迪透露，大卫·帕克·雷曾在他的拖车里绑架并性虐待了一名女子，将她囚禁了几天。

sentences.en: Ray struck a deal with his prisoner, agreeing to release her on one condition, that she never spoke of what happened.
sentences.zh: 雷与囚犯达成了一项协议，同意释放她，但有一个条件：她永远不能谈论发生过的事情。

sentences.en: Ray and Hendy dropped her off on the side of Highway Interstate 25, just outside the neighbouring city of Truth or Consequences.
sentences.zh: 雷和亨迪把她扔在了25号州际公路的路边，就在邻近的“真理或后果”城外。

sentences.en: Hendy referred to the woman as Angela.
sentences.zh: 亨迪称呼那名女子为安吉拉。

sentences.en: The Branners brushed off Hendy's drunken story as just that, a story, as Hendy had a reputation for saying outrageous things purely for the shock value.
sentences.zh: 布兰纳夫妇把亨迪醉酒后的故事仅仅当作一个故事，因为亨迪以为了博人眼球而说出惊人言论而闻名。

sentences.en: Consequently, the Branners never considered speaking to police about what Hendy had told them.
sentences.zh: 因此，布兰纳夫妇从未考虑过向警方谈论亨迪告诉他们的事。

sentences.en: It wasn't until they heard news of Cynthia Vigil's escape from David Parker Ray's property that the couple suspected Hendy's story about Angela could in fact be true.
sentences.zh: 直到他们听到辛西娅·维吉尔从大卫·帕克·雷的房产中逃脱的消息，这对夫妇才怀疑亨迪关于安吉拉的故事可能确实是真的。

sentences.en: The Branners weren't actually the first to mention the story.
sentences.zh: 布兰纳夫妇其实并不是第一个提到这个故事的人。

sentences.en: After Cindy Hendy's arrest, she told police about Angela, a victim Ray had left on the side of a highway back in February.
sentences.zh: 辛迪·亨迪被捕后，她告诉警方关于安吉拉的事，那是雷在二月份扔在公路边的一名受害者。

sentences.en: Between Deputy Gary Labor, the Branners, and Cindy Hendy, it appeared all of them were referring to the same woman.
sentences.zh: 从加里·拉博副手、布兰纳夫妇到辛迪·亨迪，他们似乎指的都是同一个女人。

sentences.en: By piecing these stories together, investigators gathered that Ray and Hendy had abducted Angela in February
sentences.zh: 通过拼凑这些故事，调查人员推断雷和亨迪在二月份绑架了安吉拉，

sentences.en: and held her captive for several days before releasing her on Interstate 25, where she was picked up by Deputy Gary Labor and left in Albuquerque.
sentences.zh: 并将她囚禁了几天，然后把她释放到25号州际公路上，在那里她被加里·拉博副手搭救并留在了阿尔伯克基。

sentences.en: Then later, Hendy drunkenly confessed to the Branners about what she and Ray had done.
sentences.zh: 后来，亨迪酒后向布兰纳夫妇坦白了她和雷所做的事情。

sentences.en: Investigators were certain Angela existed and could only hold out hope she would come forward and make a report.
sentences.zh: 调查人员确信安吉拉的存在，只能寄希望于她能站出来报案。

sentences.en: But for Angelica Montano, she readily dismissed the thought of going to the police.
sentences.zh: 但对于安杰莉卡·蒙塔诺来说，她毫不犹豫地打消了去警察局的念头。

sentences.en: Since her ordeal at the hands of David Parker Ray and Cindy Hendy,
sentences.zh: 自从在大卫·帕克·雷和辛迪·亨迪手中遭遇折磨以来，

sentences.en: Angelica had been living in constant fear.
sentences.zh: 安杰莉卡一直生活在持续的恐惧中。

sentences.en: Considering herself lucky to have even survived,
sentences.zh: 她认为自己能活下来已经是万幸了，

sentences.en: Angelica made an abrupt move to Albuquerque on the day of her release, leaving her life in truth or consequences behind.
sentences.zh: 安杰莉卡在获释当天就匆忙搬到了阿尔伯克基，抛下了她在“真理或后果”城的生活。

sentences.en: She hoped creating distance between herself and her captors would stop them from coming after her again.
sentences.zh: 她希望与绑架者拉开距离能阻止他们再次找上门来。

sentences.en: Angelica had already broken her promise to remain silent.
sentences.zh: 安杰莉卡已经打破了她保持沉默的承诺。

sentences.en: Twice.
sentences.zh: 两次。

sentences.en: First, she spoke of her captivity to the man she hitched a ride from to Albuquerque, and then again to a close friend when she arrived in town.
sentences.zh: 第一次，她向那个载她去阿尔伯克基的男人讲述了她的囚禁经历，第二次是在她到达城里后向一位密友讲述了此事。

sentences.en: Fearing what Ray would do to her if he found out she broke her part of the deal,
sentences.zh: 担心如果雷发现她打破了协议会对自己做出什么事，

sentences.en: Angelica decided not to make matters worse by reporting the incident to authorities.
sentences.zh: 安杰莉卡决定不向当局报告此事，以免事态恶化。

sentences.en: A month later, Angelica's friend heard of the arrests of David Parker Ray and Cindy Hendy,
sentences.zh: 一个月后，安杰莉卡的朋友听说了大卫·帕克·雷和辛迪·亨迪被捕的消息，

sentences.en: and convinced Angelica it was now safe for her to return to Elephant Butte and report her abduction to police.
sentences.zh: 并说服安杰莉卡现在回象山向警方报告她的绑架案是安全的。

sentences.en: It was shortly before 3pm on March 27, when investigators combing David Parker Ray's house noticed a car pull up to the roadblock outside.
sentences.zh: 3月27日下午3点前不久，正在搜查大卫·帕克·雷住所的调查人员注意到一辆车停在了外面的路障前。

sentences.en: A woman emerged, introducing herself as Angelica Montaño.
sentences.zh: 一名女子走了出来，自称是安杰莉卡·蒙塔诺。

sentences.en: In the early months of 1999,
27-year-old Angelica Montaño was living with her partner and young son in truth or consequences.
sentences.zh: 27岁的安杰莉卡·蒙塔诺与她的伴侣和年幼的儿子住在“真理或后果”城。

sentences.en: On February 17, Angelica made a trip to the local shops to purchase ingredients to bake a cake for her boyfriend.
sentences.zh: 2月17日，安杰莉卡去当地商店购买原料，准备给男友烤蛋糕。

sentences.en: Whilst Angelica walked along the main strip of town, a motorhome pulled up beside her.
sentences.zh: 当安杰莉卡走在镇上的主干道时，一辆房车停在她身边。

sentences.en: Looking up at the vehicle, she saw Cindy Hendy through the passenger side window.
sentences.zh: 她抬头看向车内，透过副驾驶侧的车窗看到了辛迪·亨迪。

sentences.en: The two women already knew each other.
sentences.zh: 这两个女人本来就认识。

sentences.en: They weren't close, but they moved in the same social circles and had crossed paths several times before.
sentences.zh: 她们并不亲近，但处于同一个社交圈，之前曾多次碰面。
